commands.name: CreateNetworkElement
steps: normalize descriptive/matching inputs and preview duplicate candidates outside lock
inside UoW require active Site and revalidate every optional relation independently
allocate immutable network_element_id; insert receipt before any receipt-FK child row, then insert Network Element/created event and explicit unracked placement projection initially
apply optional Model, placement, Cloud and IP mutations through the same owning reducers/UoW without nested receipts
audit entity and relationship result refs and commit
rules: minimum valid Network Element is Site + nonblank operational name
optional relation failure aborts the whole requested creation scope rather than silently dropping it

commands.name: UpdateNetworkElementDescriptive
steps: normalize values/show duplicate candidates
inside UoW load exact element and reject Site mutation
insert receipt/update accepted descriptive fields/revision and append descriptive event
audit/commit
rules: duplicate candidates remain warnings/reconciliation evidence only

commands.name: ChangeNetworkElementLifecycle
steps: inside UoW archive/reactivate exact identity; archive preserves placement/containment/Cloud/IP/model/component/resolution history and does not cascade unlink
reactivate requires authoritative Site active
insert receipt/update lifecycle/event/audit/commit
rules: archived element unavailable for new active Device Reference/Cloud/placement/component relationships until reactivated
existing historical/current relationship evidence is preserved and presented with archived warning

commands.name: RegularizeDeviceReference
input: target Network Element or new Network Element inputs
deliberate action proof when linking/correcting through governed promotion UI
steps: outside lock run DEVICE_REFERENCE_REGULARIZATION_V1 preview and show descriptive candidates without auto-selection
verify required LLD-12 DeliberateActionProof before entering the mutation boundary
inside UoW re-read Device Reference/current resolution and target/base state
insert the single outer command receipt before any LLD-08 or participant row references command_id
for create_and_link invoke the receipt-free Network Element creation reducer in the same UoW; for existing target require active Network Element
append resolution event/current relationship
never update any Ticket/Task/Inventory relationship target
audit Device Reference/Network Element/resolution refs and commit
rules: nested reducers never insert a second receipt or commit independently
terminal Ticket context does not block regularization
multiple Device References to one Network Element require explicit reviewed link, never descriptive auto-merge

hard_delete: Beta 1.0 exposes no ordinary hard delete for history-bearing Network Elements. A future untouched-draft deletion path would require explicit dependency contract and is not inferred from archival.
